Name: Copper Pan Cowboy Hat
Author: Nedacman
Description:
I've always hated the copper pan's functionality. It takes up a valuable inventory slot for not much return on investment. You *could* wear it on your head to free up the spot, but that looks terrible. So why not make it just... not?

This mod changes the Copper Pan's hat sprite to a custom 'Copper Cowboy Hat' based off of the Blue Cowboy Hat. If you're not a fan of that, it also has functionality to replace it with the Black, Blue, Red, or Brown Cowboy Hats.

Now updated for 1.6 with new sprites for the steel, gold, and iridium pans!

It should work with any mod that doesn't modify the Copper Pan's hat sprite. It has functionality with the Generic Mod Config Menu, but it is not required.

Downloads.Description: All-in-one copper, steel, gold, and iridium pan hat replacer!
